candidates.verbatim_passage: The Canadian Forest Fire Danger Rating System (CFFDRS) addresses these factors daily in the Canadian Forest Fire Weather Index (FWI) system (Van Wagner, 1987), a system that has seen uptake not only in North America but also in New Zealand, Mexico, parts of Europe and southeast Asia (Taylor and Alexander, 2006). Daily and hourly temperature, humidity, wind speed and precipitation are used to estimate the various FWI system indices.
